candidates.prompt:
Create a production-ready square 1024 x 1024 seamless tileable ALBEDO / BASE COLOR wall material for a cat-world cyberpunk rainy-night miniature city game. This is a FLAT orthographic texture image filling the complete square, not a perspective view of a building, not a photograph of a room, and not a material sphere. Mid-value desaturated dark steel and dirty muted colors, believable fine surface wear for an old exterior, controlled contrast readable at game scale. Truly periodic on BOTH axes: every shape cut at an edge must continue in the exact corresponding position on the opposite edge; matching edge colors, no border or frame. Avoid unique large stains at the tile center and keep the same statistical color and detail distribution across the entire square. Only base color: absolutely uniform diffuse illumination, no directional highlights, no drop shadows, no vignette, no bright center, no gradient, no baked neon reflection, no specular reflections or glossy glare. The engine will provide all lighting. No words, no logos, no signage, no UI, no characters, no human faces. Detailed restrained environment art, not a cartoon drawing. Render one texture only, edge to edge, at 1024 x 1024.
VARIANT 1 — old charcoal-gray riveted steel panel facade. Shallow rectangular panel joints in a clean orthogonal repeating grid, rows of small flush rivets, delicate scratched galvanized grain, a few understated rust freckles and grime at joins. Mostly dark warm gunmetal, subtle cool gray zinc mottling and muted brown corrosion. Panels have thin understated seams, without harsh black outlines. A consistent panel module must continue at all four edges. Do not put a frame around the image.

candidates.prompt:
Rebuild the supplied material as a strictly SEAMLESS PERIODIC game albedo tile. Retain the same material family and palette, but rearrange the sheet pattern to solve the seam problem. Flat base color only, no light baked in.

CRITICAL LAYOUT: Each of the FOUR texture edges cuts THROUGH THE CENTER OF A VERY THIN DARK METAL PANEL JOINT. There must be only HALF a thin joint at each edge, so when identical tiles touch they form ONE normal joint the same thickness as an internal joint. There is NO short extra strip of metal at the top or bottom. Internal horizontal joints are at exactly 25%, 50%, and 75% of image height. For the plate variants, vertical joints are at exactly 25%, 50%, and 75% of width. The outer joints are at exactly 0% and 100%. A texture repeated 2x2 produces uniformly spaced full sheets, not a double seam near the repetition boundary. Edge joint color is a consistent matte dark neutral metal gray on all four edges, with no broken flakes crossing it, so opposing edges match. Physical panel joints are subtle, narrow, and the same contrast as inner joints. Do not add an image frame, broad black border or vignette.

MATERIAL: charcoal-gray flat riveted steel with zinc mottling and tiny muted rust speckles. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equally sized full metal sheets. Small flat matte circle fasteners near each seam, no sphere lighting.

All surfaces are ABSOLUTELY UNLIT. Remove every specular shine, directional bevel, spherical rivet highlight, relief shadow and directional broad gradient. Thin joints represent dirt color, not a lit crevice. Avoid strong scratches at the very edge. Fine color wear distributed across all panels with balanced brightness. Nothing but the flat square surface, completely filling the image. No perspective, building, material ball, background, writing or neon. 1024x1024 base-color texture.
candidates.selection_note: 采用；从物理板缝中心提取一个完整周期用于规格化导出。
